title: Place of Supply
outcomes: Determine place of supply of goods.
Determine place of supply of services within India.
Determine place of supply in cross-border services.

meta.exam_tip: Identify whether section 12 or 13 applies before choosing the specific rule.

concepts.title: Inter-State and intra-State supply
body: A supply is inter-State if the supplier sits in one State or UT and the place of supply falls in another (section 7 of the IGST Act); intra-State where both are in the same State (section 8). Imports, exports and supplies to or by SEZ units or developers are inter-State.

Supplies to international tourists leaving India and supplies in the taxable territory not otherwise intra-State are also inter-State. An establishment in a State and another in another State are treated as establishments of distinct persons.
Wrongly paying IGST instead of CGST + SGST (or vice versa) does not attract interest: the taxpayer pays the correct tax and claims refund of the wrong tax.
concepts.analogy: Supplier location vs place of supply decides the tax type.
concepts.work: A Mumbai supplier billing a Pune buyer charges CGST + SGST.

concepts.title: Place of supply of goods
body: Section 10: where goods move, place of supply is where movement terminates for delivery; in bill-to-ship-to cases where goods are delivered to a third person on a person's direction, it is the principal place of business of the person directing; where goods do not move, the location at the time of delivery; goods assembled or installed — place of installation; goods on board a conveyance — place where taken on board.
Section 10(1)(ca): for goods supplied to unregistered persons, place of supply is the address recorded in the invoice (naming the State suffices), else the supplier's location.
Section 11 for imports and exports: imported goods — location of the importer; exported goods — location outside India.
concepts.analogy: Follow the goods, except where a buyer directs delivery to someone else.
concepts.work: Goods sold to a Punjab dealer but shipped to Haryana have place of supply in Punjab.

concepts.title: Place of supply of services within India
body: Section 12(2) default: to a registered person — location of recipient; to others — address on record, otherwise location of supplier. Specific rules: immovable property and hotel accommodation — location of property; restaurant, beauty, health and fitness services — where performed; training — recipient's location if registered, else where performed; admission to events — where event held.

Organising events: registered recipient's location, else event location; transport of goods and passengers — registered recipient's location, else where goods handed over or journey begins; telecommunication — by connection type; banking and insurance — recipient's address on record; advertising to government — each State in proportion.
Where both supplier and recipient are in India, these rules apply even if services are performed abroad (with specific exceptions).
concepts.analogy: Domestic services: mostly recipient-based, with property and event exceptions.
concepts.work: A Delhi firm training a registered Bengaluru client has place of supply in Karnataka.

concepts.title: Place of supply in cross-border services
body: Section 13 applies where either the supplier or recipient is outside India. Default — location of recipient (or supplier if recipient location is unknown). Performance-based services on goods physically made available or requiring physical presence — where performed; immovable property — location of property; events — where held.

Specific rules: banking services to account holders, transport of goods other than by mail, and hiring of conveyances up to a month — location of supplier; online information and database access (OIDAR) — location of recipient; passenger transportation — where passenger embarks.

Intermediary services: section 13(8)(b) was omitted by the Finance Act 2026 from 30 March 2026, so such services now follow the default rule — location of recipient — and services to foreign recipients can qualify as exports.
concepts.analogy: Cross-border services: recipient-based by default, with key exceptions.
concepts.work: Commission earned from a US principal is now an export of services.

illustrations.title: Bill-to-ship-to and movement of goods
illustrations.q: Anant Ltd (Haryana) sells goods worth ₹5,00,000 (18%) to Brijesh & Co (Punjab), who asks Anant to deliver them to its customer Chhavi in Haryana. Separately, Anant sells goods worth ₹5,00,000 to a Haryana buyer, delivered within Haryana. Determine place of supply and tax.

head: Supply
Place of supply
Tax (₹)
rows: Principal place of business of Brijesh — Punjab (section 10(1)(b)); inter-State
Where movement terminates for Chhavi — Haryana; inter-State from Punjab
solution.title: IGST Act section 10

checks.label: CGST (and equal SGST) on intra-State supply (₹)

illustrations.title: Intermediary after the 2026 amendment
illustrations.q: Nikhil, a commission agent in Mumbai, arranges sales of Indian handicrafts for a US buyer and earns commission of ₹20,00,000 in foreign currency in October 2026. Determine the place of supply and whether it is an export of services.

head: Point
Analysis
Result
rows: Section 13(8)(b) omitted w.e.f. 30 March 2026; default rule section 13(2)
Supplier in India, recipient outside, POS outside, paid in convertible foreign exchange, not merely establishments of one person
solution.title: IGST Act section 13

checks.label: GST that would apply if the service were not an export (₹)

jobs.title: POS review of invoices
jobs.situation: A company is unsure whether to charge IGST or CGST + SGST on several contracts.
steps: Identify supplier location and recipient registration.
Correct tax type and seek refunds of wrong tax.
jobs.takeaway: Wrong tax type means paying again and claiming refund.

traps: Treating intermediary services as taxable in India after the 2026 change.

viva.model: When the supplier is located in one State or UT and the place of supply lies in a different one.

viva.q: A machine is sold by a Gujarat firm and erected at a Kerala factory. Where is the place of supply?
viva.model: Kerala, because the goods are assembled or installed at site there.

viva.q: What is the place of supply of admission to a concert?
viva.model: The place where the event is actually held.

viva.q: What is the place of supply of performance-based services on goods abroad?
viva.model: The place where the services are actually performed.

viva.q: How did the Finance Act 2026 affect intermediaries?
viva.model: It omitted section 13(8)(b), so the default recipient-location rule now applies.
